# Amadi Jason

> Professional portfolio of Amadi Jason, a Software Engineer based in Lagos, Nigeria.
> Full-stack web development (React, TypeScript, NestJS, Go), real-time systems,
> telematics infrastructure, and applied AI. Open to roles and collaboration.

- [About](https://amadi-jason.vercel.app/#about): background, profile, and what I do.
- [Expertise](https://amadi-jason.vercel.app/#expertise): frontend, backend, real-time systems, DevOps.
- [Experience](https://amadi-jason.vercel.app/#experience): work history and roles.
- [Education](https://amadi-jason.vercel.app/#education): CS50 (Harvard) and certifications.
- [Contact](https://amadi-jason.vercel.app/#contact): email, LinkedIn, and GitHub links.

## Projects

Selected work, newest first. Source code is on GitHub unless noted.

- [TIDE](https://github.com/Jasowills/TIDE): open-source telematics infrastructure in Go.
  Turns raw vehicle signals into state, events, and actions through a single pipeline
  (validate, dedup, durable log, state engine, versioned rules, NATS JetStream, webhooks)
  with deterministic replay and FleetSim simulation.
- [Pulse](https://github.com/Jasowills/pulse): real-time data synchronization library for .NET
  over SignalR with typed change feeds from MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server.
- [Sonar](https://github.com/Jasowills/watchDog): full-stack observability platform with
  monitoring, incidents, deployments, error ingestion, and a public status page.
  Live demo: [sonar-dev.vercel.app](https://sonar-dev.vercel.app).
- [DocFlow](https://github.com/Jasowills/docflow): AI workflow documentation platform that
  records browser flows and generates guides, test cases, and release notes.
  Live demo: [docflow-ops.vercel.app](https://docflow-ops.vercel.app).
- [Folio](https://github.com/Jasowills/folio): AI-powered resume builder with ATS-optimized
  templates and interview preparation.
- [Jename](https://jenamee.com): e-commerce platform for an art and jewelry brand
  (Next.js, Payload CMS). Live site: [jenamee.com](https://jenamee.com).
- [Resortify](https://github.com/Jasowills/Resortify-hotel-reservation-system): hotel
  reservation system with 3D room viewer and admin dashboard.
- [klyq](https://github.com/Jasowills/klyq): real-time social platform with live feed,
  follows-only timelines, and WebGL visuals. Live demo: [klyq.vercel.app](https://klyq.vercel.app).
- [Wayfarer](https://github.com/Jasowills/Wayfarer): bus and rail booking platform.
  Live demo: [wayfarer-seven-zeta.vercel.app](https://wayfarer-seven-zeta.vercel.app).
- All repositories: [github.com/Jasowills](https://github.com/Jasowills).
